readings.bibliographic_proposal: John Stuart Mill, The Subjection of Women. 1869 is printed on the mirrored title page; Project Gutenberg eBook 27083, release header 2008-10-28.
readings.review_question: How can this selected passage inform an item while preserving rival interpretations?
readings.relevance: Separates equal standing between adult partners from their division of work; challenges inference of natural preferences from behavior under existing subordination.
readings.limits: Historical argument, not a measure of contemporary feminist commitments. Mirror transcription inspected, not collated against a critical edition.
readings.retrieval_note: Public-domain mirror; selected passages only, not a critical-edition comparison.

readings.review_question: How can this selected passage inform an item while preserving rival interpretations?

readings.bibliographic_proposal: Peter Kropotkin, Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution. Mirrored historical work conventionally dated 1902; repository metadata gives 1902 publication and identifies Project Gutenberg eBook 4341.
